messages:
Evan (Sales): Quick handoff Lodestar signed. Key asks: Okta SSO, VPC peering, and reserved capacity estimate. CFO wants predictable p95 for in-app answers. Priya to own CS.
Priya (CS): On it. TL;DR: initial scope 8k MAU, bursty traffic (chat + rerank). Pilot requested in 3 weeks.
Marta (Solutions): Ill draft two options: Dedicated pool (reserved) + overflow hosted, and hosted-only with aggressive caching. Need QPS and avg token lengths.
Evan (Sales): They said sustained QPS ~25, bursts 100 for <10m, avg seq ~110 tokens. Target p95 < 300ms.
Devon (Support): Ill prepare runbook and monitoring dashboard. Suggest metrics: p50/p95/p99, error rate, cache hit. Also recommend prefix cache for rerank.
Priya (CS): Owners: Priya (onboarding), Marta (infra design), Devon (post-go ops). Action: Evan intro to security lead (today). Marta: open ENG-7050 w/ TCO options (48h). Devon: runbook + alerts (48h). Priya: pilot plan + kickoff (24h).
BillingBot: Finance note: customer requested line-itemed monthly TCO (reserved vs hosted) and quantization delta. Use billing calc.
Marta (Solutions): ENG-7050 created: "Lodestar capacity options". Added int8 vs fp16 delta (~30% savings est, note small eval delta).
Devon (Support): Runbook stub added to ENG-7050: monitors and autoscale/failover steps. Dropping canary script for tail latency tests.
Priya (CS): Need Okta metadata and CIDR for peering. Evan please intro Maya at Lodestar.
Evan (Sales): Maya (maya@lodestar.ai) is security lead. Sending intro now.
Priya (CS): Summary posted: will reconvene here after ENG-7050 draft and intro email. :thumbsup:
